title: Man's Search for Meaning
author: Viktor E. Frankl
summary: Psychiatrist Viktor Frankl describes his years in Nazi concentration camps, then sets out logotherapy, his idea that the main drive in life is to find meaning. Even in extreme suffering, he argues, people keep the freedom to choose their attitude.
readIf: you want a short, moving book about resilience and finding purpose in hardship.
skipIf: you are not ready for first-hand accounts of camp life and its cruelty.
